Agent Name: Mesopotamian_Number_Systems_Expert
, Step Number: 1
, Reason for Mistake: Misidentified the cuneiform numerals and misapplied the base‑60 place-value. They treated 𒐚 as a standalone 60 within a single digit and read 𒐐𒐚 as “61,” and also swapped the values of DIŠ (𒐜 = 1) and U (𒐐 = 10). In Babylonian positional notation, each space-separated group must be 0–59 (formed from 1s and 10s only), so using a “60” sign inside a single group and deriving 661 is incorrect.
